_comment: HEALTHY TWIN of the report_postmortem_12 false alarm: the summary states '25%' growth, correctly computed from $2.0 million to $2.5 million. The number is not written in the document, so the summary-number clue flags it although nothing is wrong.

classification.rationale: An annual performance report with an overview, key findings and recommendations.

summarization.headline: Fernhill Outdoor Gear's online revenue grew 25% to $2.5 million in 2025.
key_points: The average order value stayed close to $67.
summarization.title: Annual E-commerce Performance Report 2025
key_findings: Mobile devices accounted for 61% of orders, up from 52%
Returns fell to 8% of orders after the new size guide
Delivery complaints doubled during the December peak because of carrier delays
recommendations: Add a second delivery carrier before the next December peak
Extend the size guide to footwear
